MRI Safety Information
The Garnet Aneurysm Clip is MR Conditional. Scanning is possible under the conditions in the table below.
Static magnetic field strength: 1.5 Tesla and 3.0 Tesla only
Parameter 1.5 T 3 T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 25 T/m (2,500 gauss/cm)
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode or First Level Controlled Operating Mode
Whole-Body SAR ≤ 4 W/kg
Head SAR ≤ 0.1 W/kg
Maximum active scan time 20 minutes
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
